description: Source code for handling Slack interactive reply components, including parsing choices, building message blocks, and enabling interactive replies within a Slack integration for the openclaw project.

methods.name: parseChoice
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a SlackChoice object, optionally allowing style attributes.

methods.name: parseChoices
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into an array of SlackChoice objects, respecting max items and style options.

methods.name: buildTextBlock
methods.description: Creates a text block for Slack message from a string.

methods.name: buildButtonsBlock
methods.description: Builds a Slack buttons block from a raw string of choices.

methods.name: buildSelectBlock
methods.description: Builds a Slack select block from a raw string of options.

methods.name: hasSlackBlocks
methods.description: Checks if the payload contains Slack blocks.

methods.name: parseSimpleSlackOptions
methods.description: Parses a simple comma-separated string into Slack choices if valid.

methods.name: resolveInteractiveRepliesFromCapabilities
methods.description: Determines if interactive replies are enabled based on capabilities object.

methods.name: isSlackInteractiveRepliesEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Slack interactive replies are enabled for a given configuration and account.

methods.name: compileSlackInteractiveReplies
methods.description: Processes a ReplyPayload to add Slack interactive blocks based on directives in the text.

methods.name: parseSlackOptionsLine
methods.description: Parses options line in the text to generate Slack button or select blocks.
